SELECT v.video_id AS videoId, v.video_url AS videoUrl, v.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, v.title AS title, v.view_count AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reaction r WHERE r.video_id = v.video_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.video_id = v.video_id AND c.is_deleted = false) AS commentCount, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reaction r WHERE r.video_id = v.video_id AND r.user_id = #{userId}) AS liked, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM subscription s WHERE s.category_id = v.category_id AND s.user_id = #{userId}) AS subscribed
FROM video v WHERE v.video_id = #{videoId}
